column1: # What kapelos site audit checks in the store's own settings.
# A module is checked in app/etc/config.php; a setting in the database, where a missing row keeps Magento's safe default.

column5: admin sessions, lockouts and password rules all come from this module
the admin has no second factor, so a stolen password is enough
no content security policy is sent, so an injected script runs unhindered
no CAPTCHA can be shown at login, so passwords can be guessed at speed
templates load through symlinks from outside the module, a known route to running code
admin forms stop checking their form key, so another site can submit them in an admin's session
admin accounts are never locked, however many logins fail
an admin session lasts longer than a day
an admin is never made to replace an expired password
template hints show the store's file paths to every visitor
